source_text:
# My Family and School

My father is a doctor and my mother is a teacher. I have one brother and one sister.
Every morning we walk to school together. At school, my teacher gives us a new book
to read. In winter it is cold, and in summer it is very hot. My family is happy
when we eat dinner together at home.
